info.title: Curalis API
info.description:
Clinic appointment and follow-up platform. Patients book with doctors, describe symptoms up front, and get a plain-language summary and medication reminders after the visit. Doctors get an AI-prepared brief before each consultation. Admins manage doctors, working hours, leave, and notification delivery.

Authentication: the access token is a short-lived JWT returned by login/register/refresh, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The refresh token travels separately as an httpOnly cookie and is never exposed to JavaScript.

timesOfDayMinutes.description: Minutes from local midnight, patient's timezone

payload.description: PRE_VISIT: { urgency, chiefComplaint, suggestedQuestions[] }. POST_VISIT: { summary, medicationSchedule[], followUpSteps[] }.

post.description: Patients only — doctor and admin accounts are provisioned separately. Sets the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie.

429.description: Rate limited — too many attempts from this IP
Rate limited — too many attempts from this IP

post.summary: Silently refresh the session using the httpOnly refresh cookie
post.description: Refresh tokens are single-use and rotated on every call. Reusing an already-consumed token revokes every active session for that user.
Revokes the current refresh token and clears the cookie.

get.summary: Get the current user

patch.description: Name, phone, and timezone only — email is the login identity and is not editable here.

post.description: Revokes all refresh tokens on success, signing out every other session.

get.summary: Search doctors
get.description: Unauthenticated. Only returns doctors who are active and currently accepting patients.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search over name and specialisation

get.summary: Get a doctor's public profile
List distinct specialisations currently offered
Get a doctor's bookable slots for one date
get.description: Computed fresh on every request from working hours minus leave minus already-booked/held slots — there is no stored slot table.

422.description: Date in the past or beyond the doctor's booking horizon

get.summary: A doctor's own appointments for one date
Confirmed appointments whose time has passed but have no visit note yet
A doctor's own working hours and upcoming leave (read-only)
get.description: Working hours and leave are set by an admin; this is the doctor's own read access to them.

get.summary: List every doctor with aggregated stats
get.description: Unlike GET /doctors, includes doctors who are inactive or not accepting patients. Working days, appointments in the next 7 days, on-leave-today, and today's appointment count are all pre-aggregated.

post.description: The server generates a temporary password and returns it once — it is never retrievable again.

409.description: Email or licence number already taken

get.summary: Full admin-only doctor detail
get.description: Includes fields the public/patient-facing endpoints deliberately omit (licence number, active flag, booking horizon, lead time), plus working hours, leave, and upcoming appointments.

patch.summary: Update a doctor's account/professional details, or deactivate/reactivate

requestBody.description: At least one field required. Same shape as create, minus email, plus isActive.

put.summary: Replace a doctor's entire working-hours set
put.description: Full replace, not merge — send every shift the doctor should have, including ones that are unchanged. Shifts on the same day must not overlap.

422.description: Overlapping shifts on the same day

post.summary: Hold a slot for 10 minutes while the patient fills in symptoms
post.description: Serialised per-doctor via a Postgres advisory lock plus an exclusion constraint — a slot can never be double-held/booked even under concurrent requests.

409.description: Slot no longer available, or doctor unavailable/on leave

422.description: Outside working hours, in the past, beyond horizon, or below minimum lead time

post.summary: Confirm a held slot with the patient's symptom intake

403.description: Not your hold, or hold token mismatch

post.description: Patients and doctors cancel their own; admins cancel any. The canceller's role determines the resulting status.

409.description: Only a confirmed appointment can be cancelled

patch.summary: Move a confirmed appointment to a new time
patch.description: One atomic transaction: the old row becomes RESCHEDULED and a brand-new CONFIRMED row is created (new id, returned as appointmentId) carrying forward the symptom form, AI summary, and calendar sync state.

200.description: Rescheduled — note the returned id is a new appointment, not the one in the path

409.description: Not confirmed, doctor unavailable, or the new slot is taken

get.summary: List the current patient's appointments
Get one appointment's full detail
get.description: Scoped by relationship, not just role — a patient or doctor can only fetch an appointment they're actually party to. Admins can fetch any.

get.summary: Doctor's AI-prepared brief for an upcoming appointment
get.description: Generated automatically when the patient confirms booking. status is PENDING until the LLM job completes (needs the background worker running).

200.description: Summary and the underlying symptom form

post.description: Ownership is per-type: only the doctor may regenerate PRE_VISIT, only the patient may regenerate POST_VISIT.

403.description: Wrong role for this summary type

post.description: Transitions the appointment CONFIRMED → COMPLETED and triggers the post-visit AI summary job. Doctor-only, one submission per appointment.

get.summary: Patient's plain-language visit summary
get.description: status is PENDING until the doctor's notes have been turned into a patient-facing summary (needs the background worker running).

200.description: Summary and the source visit note

get.summary: Get the prescription already submitted for this appointment, if any
get.description: Prescription.appointmentId is unique with no update path — this exists so the doctor UI can detect an existing prescription before offering to submit another.

200.description: Prescription, or null if none yet

post.summary: Submit a prescription for an appointment
post.description: Supersedes the patient's previous ACTIVE prescription (if any), cancelling its still-pending reminders, and materialises new MedicationReminder rows for the dispatch worker. Exactly one prescription may ever be submitted per appointment.

timesOfDayMinutes.description: Overrides the frequency's default reminder times. Omit to use the default.

get.summary: List the current patient's prescriptions
get.description: Ordered newest first. Only one prescription is ACTIVE at a time; older ones are SUPERSEDED.

patch.summary: Turn medication email reminders on or off

post.summary: Preview which appointments a leave period would affect
post.description: Read-only — does not cancel anything. FULL_DAY takes a single local calendar date; PARTIAL takes explicit UTC instants.
Cancels every affected CONFIRMED appointment to CANCELLED_BY_CLINIC, expires overlapping HELD rows, and emails each affected patient a rebooking link. Same request shape as preview.

delete.description: Only removes the leave record itself — does not restore appointments that were already cancelled because of it.

get.summary: List emails that exhausted their automatic retries
get.description: Curalis retries failed sends automatically, waiting longer between each attempt, up to 5 times. This lists only what's still FAILED after that.

post.description: Resets status to PENDING and attempts to 0 so the background worker picks it up on its next sweep.

404.description: No FAILED row with that id

get.summary: Check whether the current user has Google Calendar connected
Get the Google consent URL to start connecting a calendar
get.description: Returns the URL as JSON rather than redirecting directly, since the access token lives in memory on the client (never a cookie) and has to be presented as a normal Authorization header — the frontend does `window.location.href = authUrl` itself.

get.summary: OAuth callback Google redirects to after consent
get.description: Not called directly by clients. A genuine browser redirect from Google, tied back to the initiating user via a signed state token rather than an Authorization header. Always ends by redirecting the browser to the frontend's Settings page with a `?calendar=` status.

302.description: Redirects to the frontend Settings page

delete.description: Best-effort revoke with Google, then always removes the local connection record regardless of whether the revoke call succeeded. Idempotent.
